_note: Narration lines (English only). Storyteller voice, third person. Each tutorial step: wait a few seconds in silence → line 1 says what's wrong with Mochi → line 2 gives a clue → line 3 says how to help. If the child does it first, the later lines are skipped. Recordings: assets/audio/vo_en_{key}.m4a (or .mp3). Keep the text the same as what was actually recorded (it is shown as the subtitle).

wake_2.text: Look at Mochi. Maybe it will wake up.

mirror_1.text: Hmm? Mochi seems to be copying you.

mirror_2.text: What if you tilt your head?

mirror_3.text: Give a little nod. Will Mochi copy you?

mirror_ok.text: Mochi is so good at copying you!

relax_2.text: The fireflies only come close to quiet friends.

relax_3.text: Let's stay nice and quiet with Mochi for a while.

inhale_1.text: Mochi wants to fly up to the clouds, but it can't fly yet…

inhale_ok.text: The fireflies are helping. Mochi is flying!

inhale_hold.text: Shh… the dewdrop is about to fall…

inhale_down.text: Mochi is coming in to land…

huff_2.text: It's shivering, and its little flame is almost out…

huff_3.text: How about a warm "haaa" to warm Mochi?

huff_ok.text: Mochi is warm now! Thank you!

cough_1.text: Oh dear, a little seed is stuck in Mochi's throat…

cough_3.text: Could a little cough help get the seed out?

egg_1.text: The dragon egg is so cold…

egg_3.text: Just like before, how about a warm "haaa" for the egg?

egg_ok.text: The egg is a little warmer!

egg_go.text: Let's keep warming it up together!
